name: Regular Texcell Slicing with Non-Linear Pre-filtering
definition: A representation of forest coverage using a volumetric texture layer composed of prism-shaped 'texcells' (base triangle on ground vertically extruded). Sliced parallel to the ground to avoid CPU-side polygon generation and 3D texture MIP-map issues.
summary: Regular Texcell Slicing renders forest scenes as ground-aligned 2D texture pyramids, enabling efficient hardware compositing and correct anti-aliasing without CPU-side polygon generation.
